name: tds
about: TDS on payments (non-salary), TY 2026-27: the old-Act section, what it covers, the rate and the yearly / single-payment limits. Under the Income-tax Act 2025 these sit in ONE table in section 393; the ITEM NUMBERS of that table were not read on the Act's text, so each row shows its old section - confirm the item with your CA before you deposit. Rates and limits are the old sections as amended by the Finance Act 2025, which the new table carries over.
